title: Cosmobox Level3 S6 campaign summary (v1)
description: The Level3 S6 campaign-level finalization marker: for each of the three geometries, the S5<->S6 primary taxonomy and continuous descriptors for M_TT/R_eff, the five-spin (S2,S3,S4,S5,S6) directional sequence with REVERSAL_COUNT_23456 and LAST_TWO_TRANSITIONS_DIRECTIONALLY_CONTINUOUS, and a descriptive-only S2/S3/S4/S5/S6 comparison for the control metrics. delta_hl_s2/direction_s2 and delta_hl_s3/direction_s3/t_x_34/c_x_34/d_x_34 and delta_hl_s4/direction_s4/t_x_45/c_x_45/d_x_45/delta_hl_s5/direction_s5 are all read from the frozen Level3 S5 reference (which itself already embeds the S2/S3/S4 values pinned from the frozen Level2 and Level3 S4 references) -- none is ever recomputed. This document is written ONLY when the campaign is fully complete (3/3 S6 cases, 3/3 geometry comparisons, same repository_commit/manifest_fingerprint/campaign_id, all cases full-spectrum with zero partial subspaces, all three frozen references verified): its mere existence on disk is the completeness marker.

campaign_status.description: Always COMPLETE: an incomplete or failed campaign never produces this document at all.

level2_reference.description: Identifies without ambiguity which frozen Level2 campaign supplied the S=2/S=3 reference data.

level3_s4_reference.description: Identifies without ambiguity which frozen Level3 S4 campaign supplied the S=4 reference data.

level3_s5_reference.description: Identifies without ambiguity which frozen Level3 S5 campaign supplied the S=5 reference data.

geometries.description: Exactly triangle, ring4, ring5 -- no more, no fewer.

available.description: value is None if and only if reason is set.

reversalCount.description: REVERSAL_COUNT_23456: 0, 1, 2, 3, or 4 when all five directions (S2,S3,S4,S5,S6) are resolved, else the literal string NOT_EVALUABLE. Descriptive only -- never a convergence criterion.

lastTwoTransitionsDirectionallyContinuou.description: YES iff sign(S4)=sign(S5)=sign(S6); NO iff the three signs are resolved and at least one of S4->S5 or S5->S6 changes sign; NOT_EVALUABLE iff any of the three signs is not resolved. Purely descriptive -- never a convergence criterion (docs/levels/level3/s6-third-extension-preregistration.md section 12).

delta_hl_s2.description: Pinned from the frozen Level3 S5 campaign-summary (itself pinned from the frozen Level2 campaign-summary) -- never recomputed.

delta_hl_s3.description: Pinned from the frozen Level3 S5 campaign-summary -- never recomputed.

delta_hl_s4.description: Pinned from the frozen Level3 S5 campaign-summary -- never recomputed from a re-executed S4 case.

delta_hl_s5.description: Pinned from the frozen Level3 S5 campaign-summary -- never recomputed from a re-executed S5 case.

t_x_45.description: abs(delta_hl_s5 - delta_hl_s4), pinned from the frozen Level3 S5 campaign-summary.

r_delta_x_56_45.description: t_x_56 / t_x_45, only when t_x_45 > 0. No threshold associated.

c_x_45.description: Pinned from the frozen Level3 S5 campaign-summary.

d_x_45.description: Pinned from the frozen Level3 S5 campaign-summary.

c_x_56.description: Computed with the same profiles.cross_profile_correlation primitive as C_X_45, on the S5<->S6 pair.

d_x_56.description: Computed with the same profiles.cross_profile_distance primitive as D_X_45, on the S5<->S6 pair.

r_d_x_56_45.description: d_x_56 / d_x_45, only when d_x_45 > 0. No threshold associated.

primaryS5S6Comparison.description: Mirrors the S5<->S6 primary comparison contract of docs/levels/level3/s6-third-extension-preregistration.md sections 8-13 exactly.

controlS5S6Comparison.description: Deliberately has NO primary_s5_s6_taxonomy/reversal_count_23456/last_two_transitions_directionally_continuous/shape-descriptor property -- additionalProperties:false makes it a schema error to include one (control channel never creates or overrides a primary result).
